context: Two teens plan a beach-and-museum trip
purpose: Teach: サーフィン/シャンプー/ピラミッド/食器/名曲/唄/大家/染め

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、サーフィン体験行きたい!
lines.en: I want to try surfing over summer break!
lines.style: Bright, open excitement. Quick breath at the start. Builds energy through the line. Final word lands with genuine eagerness, not performative.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね。海あがりにシャンプー必須だな。
lines.en: Yeah, sounds good. You'll definitely need to shampoo after though.
lines.style: Relaxed agreement, then practical observation. Slight knowing amusement—not lecturing, just matter-of-fact. Casual delivery, like he's thought about this before.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 帰りに博物館のピラミッド展、寄ろうよ。
lines.en: Let's stop by the pyramid exhibit at the museum on the way back.
lines.style: Casual confidence. She's already thinking ahead, planning the route. Light energy—suggesting something she thinks he'll want to do too. Not pushing, inviting.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 食器のお土産も買いたい。古代の名曲、流れてる展示室あるって。
lines.en: I want to grab some pottery as a souvenir. And I heard there's a room playing ancient music too.
lines.style: Genuine interest breaks through his cool exterior. Steady pace, but attentive—he's sharing something he actually cares about. Soft on 'ancient music,' like he's admitting something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 歌の唄上手な吟遊詩人がライブやるって聞いた!
lines.en: I heard some really talented musicians do live performances there!
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm with a slight self-aware edge. She's sharing something she's genuinely into without overthinking it. Energy is warm, not trying too hard.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 帰り、大家さんに頼んで、染め物体験も予約しようかな。
lines.en: Maybe I'll ask the landlord on the way back to book us a dye-craft workshop too.
lines.style: Thoughtful, building out a plan. Practical tone with underlying warmth—he's already picturing them doing this together. Deliberate pacing, like he's weighing the idea as he says it.
